def solve(i, mode='maxmin'):
    a=np.array(i); H,W=a.shape
    cnti=Counter(int(x) for r in a.tolist() for x in r); bgc=max(cnti,key=lambda k:cnti[k])
    objs=[(vv,c) for vv in set(int(x) for r in a.tolist() for x in r)-{bgc} for c in comps(a,vv)]
    colcomps=defaultdict(list)
    for vv,c in objs: colcomps[vv].append(c)
    sgts=[(vv,c) for vv,l in colcomps.items() if len(l)==1]
    byshape=defaultdict(list)
    for vv,c in objs: byshape[norm(c)].append(vv)
    twins=[]
    for kk,vvs in byshape.items():
        if len(vvs)>=2:
            twins.append([(vv,c) for vv,c in objs if norm(c)==kk])
    if not sgts or not twins: return [row[:] for row in i]
    out=[r[:] for r in i]
    # strategy A: pick twin member with MAX distance to its own nearest singleton(s), then recolor to color of singleton it is NEAREST TO.
    best=None
    for tws in twins:
        for vv,c in tws:
            ds=[mindist(set(map(tuple,c)),set(map(tuple,sco))) for sv,sco in sgts]
            near=min(ds)
            tgt=sgts[ds.index(near)][0] if ds else None
            cand=(near,tgt,tws)
            if best is None or near>best[0]: best=cand
    d,tgt,tws=best
    for vv,c in tws:
        for (r,cc_) in c:
            out[r][cc_]=tgt
    return out
